new_value: Fix in ef3d291b3d (fix(coap): authz gate for POST lichen-gw/slots). SPEC: no deviation from house pattern - GCP-6.4:119 'All CoAP messages use OSCORE' and GCP-6.5 validation step 1 'Verify OSCORE protection' mandate the OSCORE dispatch boundary for slot claims; GCP-6.3:104 mandates silent discard for invalid/missing signatures (object-level Schnorr48 kept, coap_slot_coord.c:298-334 unchanged). CHANGES (coap_slot_coord.c slots_post, :974-1055): coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request() at dispatch; house gate (!oscore.is_protected && !lichen_coap_is_local_admin) -> 4.01 via coap_oscore_respond_resource; payload now read from oscore.payload (decrypted); all responses via coap_oscore_respond_resource (protected peers get protected responses); BEHAVIOR FIX per GCP-6.3 acceptance(3): LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_NO_SIG/INVALID_SIG now return 0 with NO response (silent discard) instead of the old 4.00; CONFLICT->4.09 and other rejects unchanged; grant/2.01 unchanged. Kconfig (coap/Kconfig:327): fixed dangling dep LICHEN_SCHNORR48 (defined nowhere in tree -> endpoint was unreachable in every build, contradicting the bead premise) to LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR (matches the file's own CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR guards and gcp/Kconfig:18); prerequisite for the endpoint to exist and for verification. EVIDENCE: (1) scripts/lint-c.sh profile parity - cppcheck+clang-tidy finding sets byte-identical to HEAD (17 internal-linkage + 2 branch-clone + 1 uninitvar iid_hex, all pre-existing, none in my hunks). (2) Existing suites green: west twister -p qemu_x86/atom -T lichen/tests/coap_config = 20/20 pass (plain and with extra Kconfig args), outdir /Volumes/Attic/tmp/twister-2hte-base2. (3) Module-aware compile: ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=lichen scratch build resolved CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD=y through the fixed dep and queued coap_slot_coord.c; real gcc type-checks my full handler (975-1055) with zero diagnostics; A/B vs HEAD blob with identical flags shows byte-identical error/warning sets (only pre-existing v3.7.0-only struct coap_core_metadata resource defs + Wconversion, removed in Zephyr 4.1.0; CI pins v3.7.0). Full local link blocked by that pre-existing 4.1.0 drift in untouched files (also default-y checkin/coap_client/coap_status), NOT by this change. NO NEW TEST: no slot_coord test dir exists; sibling coap suites are per-handler direct-compile (hand-set defines, no module), so a slot suite needs an OSCORE-protected client harness - that scope is exactly beads project-LICHEN-worker6-6ffc (slot authz+replay tests, notes 'no existing slot test dir') and jkli; replay tracking itself is worker6-gskf. NOTE for 6ffc implementers: has_signature is never set by lichen_slot_coord_decode_claim (pre-existing; COSE_Sign1 object-signature path unimplemented in C), so today every network claim discards at NO_SIG - consistent with GCP-6.3 fail-closed, but the valid-sig accept path (acceptance 2) is only exercisable via a COSE_Sign1 decoder or unit-level claim construction.
